question: ‘可发表级’新颖性 (Novelty) 的量化基准：通过 Semantic Scholar 或 arXiv API 检索过去 5 年相关文献，若生成假设与现有 SOTA 方法的 Jaccard Similarity < 0.3 且未出现在任何已发表论文的 Abstract/Conclusion 中，则判定为具备潜在新颖性。

sources.title: An Axiomatic Benchmark for Evaluation of Scientific Novelty Metrics
sources.snippet: The rigorous evaluation of the novelty of a scientific paper is, even for human scientists, a challenging task. With the increasing interest in AI scientists, it is becoming more and more important that this task be automatable and reliable, lest attention and compute be wasted on ideas that have already been explored.
